clue.text: Relation found in a semi-religious order?

definitions.text: Relation found in a semi-religious order?

parts.words: Relation found in a semi-religious order?
parts.note: read 'semi' as half and a member of a religious order as a monk or friar, and the clue describes a sibling sharing only one parent

explanation.surface: A relative turns up in a not-quite-monastic community.
explanation.definitionFit: A sibling with only one parent in common is a family relation; the clue's half-monk picture puns on that.

clue.text: A troublesome quantity though not beyond your grasp

definitions.text: A troublesome quantity though not beyond your grasp

parts.words: A troublesome quantity though not beyond your grasp
parts.note: a difficult child or task is called this, and literally it is as much as a hand can hold, so it is within your grasp

explanation.surface: Something tricky to deal with, yet still small enough to hold.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an unruly, demanding person and the small amount a palm can hold.

clue.text: Slow movement produced no advance

parts.note: to advance money is to lend it, so 'advance' in the past gives lent
O is the figure nought, standing for no or nothing

explanation.surface: A slow passage of music gets nowhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Produced' is a link; 'no advance' reads as nil progress, but the pieces come in the order advance (LENT) then no (O).
explanation.definitionFit: In music a tempo marking for a slow pace also names a slow section or movement of a work.

clue.text: Liberal peeress

definitions.meaning: liberal here means generous, giving freely
Lady ..., the charitable gentlewoman in Farquhar's play The Beaux' Stratagem, gives a titled lady of that name

explanation.definitionFit: Generous and plentiful are synonyms of the word, and Lady Bountiful is the stock name for a charitable noblewoman.

clue.text: The sound of a pig in agreeable surroundings

indicators.note: the word for agreeable forms surroundings for the word in, which sits inside it

parts.note: OK means acceptable or agreeable
taken as written

explanation.surface: A contented pig grunts happily in pleasant surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the conventional imitation of the grunt a pig makes.

clue.text: Colourful display of arms

parts.note: arms here are coats of arms, painted in bright tinctures, not weapons on show

explanation.surface: A vivid parade of weaponry.
explanation.definitionFit: The study and design of coats of arms produces bright armorial devices such as shields and crests.

clue.text: Relax the terms of reference

definitions.meaning: to relax a penalty or debt is to cancel or ease it
the brief given to a committee or official, setting out what they must deal with

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to ease or forgive a penalty; as a noun it is an assigned area of responsibility.

clue.text: A number making a noise in an examination

indicators.note: the word for noise goes in the word for an exam

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination
a din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: A candidate makes a racket during a test.
explanation.definitionFit: First, second and third are this kind of number, giving position in a series rather than quantity.

clue.text: Prevalence of money

definitions.meaning: the state of being widely accepted or in general use
the coins and notes in circulation in a country

explanation.definitionFit: The word means general acceptance or circulation of an idea, and also a system of money in use.

clue.text: Haricot bean, for example, not for a starter

definitions.text: Haricot bean, for example, not for a starter

parts.words: Haricot bean, for example, not for a starter
parts.note: a haricot is not a runner bean, and a horse that does not come under starter's orders in a race is described the same way

explanation.surface: A dried bean that should not be served as a first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Starter' suggests a first course, but it is the official who starts a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse withdrawn before a race takes no part, and a haricot is literally a bean that is not of the runner variety.

clue.text: Form of penicillin?

definitions.meaning: a shape or cast in which something is formed
the antibiotic was found in, and made from, a fungus growing on old food

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a cast that gives a thing its shape, and also the fungus from which the antibiotic was discovered.

clue.text: Replacing last of the footlights

indicators.note: replacing means putting the letters of the two words back in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Swapping out the final bulb of the stage lighting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Replacing' rearranges LAST and OF. In the theatre, the row of lights along the front of the stage is an old name for the footlights.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatrical name for the row of lamps along the front edge of a stage, the same thing as footlights.

clue.text: It passes for accommodation by the club

parts.note: a flat is a set of rooms to live in
an iron is a golf club

explanation.surface: A dwelling beside the golf club passes muster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For' and 'by' are links. 'It passes' is fair because this old heavy smoothing tool is passed over cloth to press it.
explanation.definitionFit: An old smoothing tool heated on a stove is pushed back and forth over clothes, so it makes passes.

clue.text: Released — or shot

definitions.meaning: freed from a duty or excused from punishment
fired, as a gun or a firework is fired

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means excused or freed, and also discharged, as a firework or a gun.

clue.text: Arrests drunkard in lift for drunkards

indicators.note: in a down clue a lift raises the words, so they read from bottom to top

parts.note: stops means halts or arrests
a sot is a habitual drunk

explanation.surface: Police arrest a drunk in an elevator, among other drunks.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue a lift carries words upward, so 'in lift' reverses the two pieces together; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for habitual heavy drinkers, people who toss back their pots of ale.

clue.text: Test food in court

indicators.note: the word for food goes in the word for a test

parts.note: a trial is a test
a bun is a small item of food

explanation.surface: Sampling the dishes at a law court.
explanation.definitionFit: A body appointed to judge disputes acts as a court.

clue.text: Promise that makes both alter

indicators.note: makes signals that the letters of both and alter are worked into a new word

explanation.surface: A vow that changes both parties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That makes' joins the definition to the fodder; 'alter' supplies letters rather than signalling.
explanation.definitionFit: An engagement to marry is a formal pledge, a promise between two people.

clue.text: Good man rebuilt a crock-for racing?

definitions.text: Good man rebuilt a crock-for racing?

parts.note: ST stands for saint, a good man

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters of a crock are reassembled in another order

explanation.surface: A saintly mechanic restores an old banger for the track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rebuilt' rearranges A CROCK into OCKCAR. A crock is British slang for an old worn-out car; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A car of this type is an ordinary saloon modified and strengthened to race on oval tracks.

clue.text: Sheridan's captain bales out when in trouble

indicators.note: in trouble signals the letters of bales out are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A naval officer bails out when his ship is in difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When' is a link. Captain Jack Absolute is the hero of Sheridan's comedy The Rivals.
explanation.definitionFit: The captain in Sheridan's play The Rivals bears this surname.

clue.text: Heavens, what a cast!

parts.note: the heavens are full of stars, and a cast made up only of celebrities is described the same way

explanation.surface: A theatregoer exclaims at an impressive line-up of actors.
explanation.definitionFit: A cast or team made up entirely of famous performers is described with this compound.

clue.text: Put off one's retirement

parts.note: retirement here means retiring to bed for the night, not leaving work

explanation.surface: Someone delays leaving their job.
explanation.definitionFit: To remain awake beyond bedtime is to postpone retiring for the night.

clue.text: Be nice to a dog and a bird, for example

parts.note: you pat a dog to show it kindness
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: Treat animals kindly, a dog and a bird say.
explanation.definitionFit: A model to be copied is an example to follow.

clue.text: Cosmetic combination of sauce and jam?

parts.note: sauce and lip both mean cheek or impudence
to jam is to get stuck, to stick

explanation.surface: A beauty product made by mixing a condiment and preserve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Combination of' and 'and' are links; sauce and jam are not food here.
explanation.definitionFit: A coloured stick for the mouth is a staple beauty product.

clue.text: What he does is appropriate

parts.note: appropriate is read as the verb meaning to take for oneself, not the adjective meaning fitting

explanation.surface: Whatever this man does is fitting and proper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who steals takes others' property for himself.

clue.text: Early rail or space traveller

parts.note: Stephenson's pioneering 1829 locomotive shares its name with the craft launched into space

explanation.surface: A pioneer of the railways or a space voyager.
explanation.definitionFit: George Stephenson's famous early locomotive and a vehicle propelled into space carry the same name.

clue.text: Mixed drink five love to imbibe in Russian city

indicators.note: the drink and the five take in, or swallow, the love between them

parts.note: kir is a mixed drink of white wine and blackcurrant liqueur
V is the Roman numeral five
O is a love, nil score in tennis

explanation.surface: Five people share a cocktail in a Russian city, lovingly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' is a link. 'Mixed' looks like an anagram signal but belongs to the definition of the drink. Kirov was a Russian city now called Vyatka.
explanation.definitionFit: The city of Vyatka in Russia bore this name in Soviet times.

clue.text: It's wrong to raise the pace

indicators.note: in a down clue raising the word for wrong reads it from bottom to top

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Speeding up is a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' and 'the' are links; 'to raise' turns TORT round in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A brisk running gait between walking and cantering is a pace.

clue.text: All the composer required

parts.note: an Italian marking on a score asks for everyone in the orchestra to play

explanation.surface: Everything a musician needed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian musical direction means all players together.

clue.text: Newly-formed orchestra has great drawing capacity

definitions.note: a verb phrase defining a noun: the animal is one that can pull a heavy load

indicators.note: newly formed says the letters of orchestra are shaped into something new

explanation.surface: A new band proves a big box-office attraction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drawing' suggests pulling in crowds, but it means pulling a cart.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy draught animal bred to pull wagons has strength for hauling.

clue.text: In organised events rifle club's best side is seen

indicators.note: organised means the letters of events and rifle are arranged into order

explanation.surface: Shooting contests show off the rifle club's top marksmen.
explanation.definitionFit: A sports club's top team, its strongest players, is fielded as its premier side.
